summary: Verify compatibility across producers, consumers, versions, and persisted formats.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Behavior, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, and exclusions.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Exact candidate revision, changed behavior, and implementation scope.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Observed system boundaries, dependencies, ownership, and execution paths.

inputs.name: migration-plan
inputs.description: Compatibility phases, data invariants, validation, and recovery procedure.

completion_checks: The supported compatibility matrix is explicit and representative contracts are executed.
Every untested supported combination has a visible limitation or release blocker.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
